  echo ""
  echo -e "${BOLD}========================================${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}        Service Health Check            ${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}========================================${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo -e "  Host    : ${HOST}"

  echo -e "  Timeout : ${TIMEOUT}s per service"
  echo -e "${BOLD}----------------------------------------${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo ""
}

  local passed=$2
  local failed=$3

  echo -e "${BOLD}----------------------------------------${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}  Summary${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}----------------------------------------${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo -e "  Total   : ${total}"
  echo -e "  ${PASS_COLOR}Healthy : ${passed}${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo -e "  ${FAIL_COLOR}Unhealthy: ${failed}${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}========================================${RESET_COLOR}"
  echo ""

    return $?
  fi
  return 1

  local port=$1
  local path=$2
  local url="http://${HOST}:${port}${path}"

  local failed=0

  else
    echo -e "${FAIL_COLOR}${BOLD}One or more services are unhealthy.${RESET_COLOR}"

  echo ""

  exit ${overall_status}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# healthcheck.sh — Service Health Check
# Checks whether services on ports 3000 and 8080 are reachable and reports
# their status with a clear summary.
# =============================================================================

# ── Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HOST="${HEALTH_CHECK_HOST:-localhost}"
TIMEOUT="${HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT:-3}"   # seconds to wait for a connection

declare -A SERVICES=(
  [3000]="Frontend"
  [8080]="Backend API"
)

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [[ -t 1 ]]; then   # only use colours when writing to a terminal
  RED="\033[0;31m"
  GREEN="\033[0;32m"
  YELLOW="\033[0;33m"
  CYAN="\033[0;36m"
  BOLD="\033[1m"
  RESET="\033[0m"
else
  RED="" GREEN="" YELLOW="" CYAN="" BOLD="" RESET=""
fi

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# check_port <port>
# Returns 0 (healthy) or 1 (unhealthy).
check_port() {
  local port="$1"
  # Use /dev/tcp if available (bash built-in, no extra tools required),
  # then fall back to nc (netcat) and finally curl.
  if (: </dev/tcp/"$HOST"/"$port") 2>/dev/null; then
    return 0
  elif command -v nc &>/dev/null; then
    nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT" "$HOST" "$port" &>/dev/null
    return $?
  elif command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
    curl --silent --max-time "$TIMEOUT" \
         --output /dev/null \
         "http://$HOST:$port" &>/dev/null
    return $?
  else
    echo -e "${YELLOW}  WARNING: No connectivity tool found (bash /dev/tcp, nc, or curl).${RESET}"
    return 2
  fi
}

print_divider() {
  echo -e "${CYAN}$(printf '─%.0s' {1..52})${RESET}"
}

# ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
main() {
  local timestamp
  timestamp="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

  local all_healthy=true
  local pass=0
  local fail=0

  print_divider
  echo -e "${BOLD}  Service Health Check${RESET}  •  ${timestamp}"
  echo -e "  Host    : ${HOST}"
  echo -e "  Timeout : ${TIMEOUT}s"
  print_divider

  # Iterate in sorted port order for consistent output
  for port in $(echo "${!SERVICES[@]}" | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -n); do
    local name="${SERVICES[$port]}"
    printf "  %-14s  port %-6s  →  " "$name" "$port"

    check_port "$port"
    local status=$?

    if [[ $status -eq 0 ]]; then
      echo -e "${GREEN}${BOLD}HEALTHY ✔${RESET}"
      (( pass++ ))
    elif [[ $status -eq 2 ]]; then
      echo -e "${YELLOW}${BOLD}UNKNOWN ?${RESET}  (no tool available)"
      all_healthy=false
      (( fail++ ))
    else
      echo -e "${RED}${BOLD}UNREACHABLE ✘${RESET}"
      all_healthy=false
      (( fail++ ))
    fi
  done

  print_divider

  # ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  local total=$(( pass + fail ))
  echo -e "  Summary : ${pass}/${total} services healthy"

  if $all_healthy; then
    echo -e "  Status  : ${GREEN}${BOLD}ALL SYSTEMS OPERATIONAL${RESET}"
    print_divider
    exit 0
  else
    echo -e "  Status  : ${RED}${BOLD}DEGRADED — ${fail} service(s) unavailable${RESET}"
    print_divider
    exit 1
  fi
}

main "$@"

log_warn()    { echo -e "${YELLOW}[$(timestamp)] WARN   ${RESET} $*"; }
log_error()   { echo -e "${RED}[$(timestamp)] DOWN   ${RESET} $*"; }

                  "${url}" 2>/dev/null) || return 1

  HTTP_BODY=$(echo "${response}"   | head -n -1)

  echo -e "${BOLD}  Summary${RESET}"
  echo -e "${BOLD}══════════════════════════════════════════════════════${RESET}"

  echo -e "  Services DOWN: ${RED}${BOLD}${down_count}${RESET}"

    echo -e "\n  ${GREEN}${BOLD}✅  All services are healthy.${RESET}\n"
  else

  fi
  echo -e "${BOLD}══════════════════════════════════════════════════════${RESET}\n"

}
